secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for AI Chat with Function Calling. Optional — the app falls back to rule-based keyword matching without it. Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
secrets.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Optional — defaults to OpenAI.

secrets.name: OPENAI_MODEL
secrets.description: Model name for AI Chat (e.g. gpt-4o-mini). Optional — defaults to gpt-4o-mini.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for transactional email (OTP verification, password reset). Optional — email sending is skipped without it. Get it from https://resend.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: SENDER_EMAIL
secrets.description: From address for transactional emails (e.g. onboarding@resend.dev). Optional.

secrets.name: SENDER_NAME
secrets.description: From name for transactional emails. Optional — defaults to QuantAI.
